ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, it is known that $AE=BE$, $DE$ is the perpendicular bisector of $AB$, and $F$ is a point on $DE$. If $BF=11\text{cm}$ and $CF=3\text{cm}$, what is the length of $AC$ in cm?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $AE=BE$, and $DE$ is the perpendicular bisector of $AB$,\\
hence, $DE$ is the median of $AB$,\\
therefore, $DE$ is the perpendicular bisector of $AB$,\\
since $F$ is a point on $DE$,\\
therefore, $AF=BF$,\\
thus, $AC = AF + CF = BF + CF$,\\
since $BF=11\,cm$, and $CF=3\,cm$,\\
therefore, $AC = \boxed{14}\,cm$
